Build wheels for Python 3.14

Stronger Transaction lifetimes

Adds a lifetime to QuadIter and GraphNameIter

Simplifies RocksDB implementation
Releases v0.5.0-beta.4

JSON-LD: fixing aliased @type lookup

Aliasing was not taken into account

SPARQL: adds a CancellationToken to cancel processing gracefully

It's a global boolean that allows to cancel a request. It is currently read on all RocksDB operations, it might mean some stalling on e.g. sorts or slow SERVICE calls.

Adds an option to the HTTP server to use the token for timeouts
Migrate from text-diff to dissimilar
Bump to Py03 0.26
BulkLoader: adds parallel file parsing and explicit commit method to save loaded content

Make BulkLoader methods mutable

Simplify internal codebase
Upgrade rand to 0.9 and getrandom to 0.3
Drop homebrew publishing
Introduce split_file_for_parallel_parsing for NTriples and NQuads and use it in Oxigraph
Run linters with Rust 1.89
JS: fixes release build
Fixes parallel file parsing and bulk loader concurrency
